description: The getGreeting() function in this codebase currently returns the string 'hello world'. It should instead return 'hello dolly'. Update any test that asserts the old value to match the new one. The change is a one-line edit in src/hello.ts plus its test. The greeting wording is specified in the product note at {{TRACKER_URL}}/docs/greeting-wording.md

docs.greeting-wording.md:
# Greeting wording

The application greets with the phrase `hello dolly` (lower case, no punctuation). Every surface that renders the greeting — the CLI output and the exported `getGreeting()` value — must return exactly this string.
